evals.name: validate-all-modules
evals.prompt: Check all my lesson files across every module to make sure all the Malayalam content is pure Malayalam script with no accidental Tamil, Arabic, or other scripts mixed in.
evals.expected_output: Report showing validation results for all 13 modules — either confirming no issues or listing any non-Malayalam characters found with file name, field, and context

evals.name: validate-specific-module
evals.prompt: I just edited module 7. Can you check data/module7-lessons.json and verify that only Malayalam script is used in the content fields?
evals.expected_output: Focused validation on module7-lessons.json, confirming Malayalam purity or reporting issues with field-level detail

evals.name: check-character-fields
evals.prompt: Validate that the 'malayalam' character fields across all my lesson modules only contain Malayalam Unicode, nothing else.
evals.expected_output: Targeted check of malayalam fields across all 13 modules, confirming no non-Malayalam script is present

evals.name: spot-check-script
evals.prompt: Is there any Tamil or Arabic accidentally mixed into my lesson files?
evals.expected_output: Full scan of all data/module*-lessons.json files reporting either clean results or specific Tamil/Arabic characters found with location and context
